scope_status: Source-derived finite candidate checklist plus named native receipt navigation. No new native passes.
method: Read actual AST descriptors and inspector/composite conditional branches. Did not import/execute project Core, run build/tests/server or browser. Existing files unchanged.

policy.finite_scope: 24 DEF module types, concrete231 direct controls, shared12 style descriptors,8 fixed Advanced descriptors, explicit runtime/composite families. Palette aliases are seeds, not new types. Dynamic collection/property/style names are generated namespaces, tested by one valid plus missing/empty/changed case per kind, not infinitely enumerated.
policy.all_static_choices: Exercise every finite select/pick option at its natural direct branch on one reference breakpoint; verify representative persistent result at D/T/M. Do not multiply every option by every state/host.
policy.numeric: Per numeric family: default/blank reset, positive representative, zero where allowed, min/below-min or negative boundary, decimal for integer controls, one permitted alternate unit plus each descriptor unit where no prior named receipt exists. One invalid draft then blur/Enter/valid correction. CSS calc/var one valid example when supported. No arbitrary numeric Cartesian matrix.
policy.text: Normal, empty/whitespace, long unbroken and escaped <>&/quote/emoji example per content family; required versus optional behavior. Safe link modes plus one inert unsafe source, never activate unsafe/external submission.
policy.toggles: Both branches, including dependent-control visibility, saved output and restoration.
policy.scope: One D/T/M inherited/explicit/reset sequence per property family; one real Hover and keyboard Focus per interactive family; class/local/shared typography/instance negative controls in prioritized combined flows.
policy.host: Every module gets HOST-CLOUD and HOST-WORDPRESS case. Unsupported provider branches reported unsupported, not passed. Native saved frontend mandatory for host acceptance.
policy.done_definition: Only mark exact case complete with source/deployment version, native actions, saved value/DOM/computed/behavior receipts, readable relevant screenshots, restoration and host/environment limits. No source/units pass substitutes for native acceptance.

palette.provider_branch: Collection list hidden unless L.dynamicContentProvider() === pagecraft. Column remains structural child type, not a direct PAL tile.
